latest.text:
Fils beat Jodar 4–6, 6–2, 6–2 in Turin to get his first win at the ATP Finals and stay in the race for the semi-finals. It was the first appearance at this event for both players.

The first set could easily have gone the other way. Fils was the one with the chances: he had break points early on and again late in the set but Jodar saved every one of them. Then Jodar broke in the very last game and took the set 6–4. Fils was angry with himself for letting it slip and he was now a set down.

From the second set the match changed. Fils broke early, broke again soon after and won 5 games in a row to take the set 6–2 and level at one set all. Once he was ahead, the set was fairly comfortable for him. The decider went the same way. He broke early, broke again late in the set and finished it 6–2.

After that first set, Fils kept pressing until the end and hit the ball with pinpoint accuracy. He was clearly the better player from the baseline and on return he kept Jodar under pressure on almost every service game. It was not perfect: he landed only 50% of his first serves, something to watch in the next round.

Jodar called the physio in the middle of the second set, when Fils was already taking control of it.

That is a comeback worth noting, because it came on Fils's first appearance at this event. Once the first set was gone, he was the stronger player on both serve and return and he finished with a dominance ratio of 1.66. Up next: Zverev.
